title: 第60章 央视认证的歌手
content_zh:
第60章 央视认证的歌手-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

领完最受欢迎歌手奖，魏沐捧着沉甸甸的水晶奖杯走进后台采访区。

镁光灯瞬间将他包围，晃得他微微眯起眼。

这次颁奖典礼，来了不少国内娱乐网站。

新浪腾迅搜狐三大门户网站，依次排开等着采访。

手里捧着奖杯，应付着媒体。

新浪记者率先发问：“这是你第一次获奖，感受如何？”

“非常不错，我要感谢MTV给了我这次机会.....”

简单回答两个问题，最后轮到搜狐，记者对最后一句话很感兴趣。

“你的最后一句获奖感言是‘欢迎来到京城看奥运’，这个是预先就想好的嘛？”

轮到这个问题，魏沐神色正经起来。

“没错，08奥运会是我们国家最重要的盛事，我想借这个机会宣传一下。”

此次颁奖典礼，将会通过MTV全球网络在162个国家或地区直播，覆盖范围很广。

不管出于什么目的，这番话确实起到了积极作用。

搜狐娱乐的记者已经想好了标题。

【MTV亚洲大奖最受欢迎歌手魏沐：奖杯之外，更盼世界看京城奥运】

次日，媒体刊登了不少有关这个奖项的报道，不少权威媒体对这个奖项比较认可。

尤其是魏沐获奖感言的最后那句话，得到不少官媒赞赏。

甚至在《东方时控》也出现了一波十几秒的短讯——

“8月2号，歌手魏沐获得MTV亚洲大奖国内地区最受欢迎歌手奖，在获奖感言中，他呼吁更多观众关注08奥运，奥运是我们......”

然后便是魏沐发表获奖感言的几秒钟镜头，西装革履帅气逼人。

好家伙，《东方时控》虽然比不上《新闻联波》，但其影响力也不差。

之前魏沐凭借新专辑火爆全国，家里最多就打几个恭喜电话。

可现在不一样，这可是《东方时控》，正儿八经的央视新闻。

本来作为学校老师的父母还觉得不好意思，现在没这个顾虑。

我家儿子上了央视新闻！！

就连一向沉默寡言的父亲，都破天荒的跟他打了半个多小时电话，言语中满是鼓励和告诫。

.........

8月4日，魏沐带着最受欢迎歌手奖杯回到了他忠诚的太合麦田。

“老宋，怎么样。”

把奖杯摆在老板办公室桌上，看向正在吞云吐雾的宋柯。

宋老板朝着他翻了一个白眼，不想看这小子装逼。

After receiving the Most Popular Singer Award, Wei Mu walked into the backstage interview area holding the heavy crystal trophy.

The spotlight instantly surrounded him, making him squint slightly.

Many domestic entertainment websites came to this award ceremony.

The three major portal websites of Sina, Tencent and Sohu were lined up one after another waiting for interviews.

Holding the trophy in hand, dealing with the media.

A Sina reporter was the first to ask: "This is your first time winning an award. How do you feel about it?"

"It's very good. I want to thank MTV for giving me this opportunity..."

Simply answer two questions, and finally it was Sohu’s turn. The reporter was very interested in the last sentence.

"Your last acceptance speech was 'Welcome to Beijing to watch the Olympics.' Was this planned in advance?"

When it was his turn to ask this question, Wei Mu looked serious.

"Yes, the 2008 Olympics is the most important event in our country. I would like to take this opportunity to promote it."

The awards ceremony will be broadcast live in 162 countries or regions through the MTV global network, covering a wide range of areas.

Regardless of the purpose, these words did have a positive effect.

Sohu Entertainment reporters have already thought of the title.

[MTV Asia Awards Most Popular Singer Wei Mu: In addition to the trophy, I also look forward to the world watching the Beijing Olympics]

The next day, the media published a lot of reports about this award, and many authoritative media recognized this award.

Especially the last sentence of Wei Mu's acceptance speech was praised by many official media.

Even in "Eastern Time Control", a wave of text messages lasting more than ten seconds appeared——

"On August 2, singer Wei Mu won the Most Popular Singer Award in the Domestic Region at the MTV Asia Awards. In his acceptance speech, he called on more viewers to pay attention to the 2008 Olympics. The Olympics are our..."

Then there are a few seconds of Wei Mu delivering his acceptance speech, looking handsome in suits and ties.

Good guy, although "Eastern Time Control" is not as good as "News Lianbo", its influence is not bad.

Before Wei Mu became popular across the country with his new album, he only received a few congratulatory calls from home.

But it's different now. This is "Eastern Time", a serious CCTV news.

My parents, who are school teachers, used to feel embarrassed, but now I don't have such worries.

My son was on CCTV news!!

Even his father, who had always been taciturn, spent more than half an hour on the phone with him for the first time, and his words were full of encouragement and admonishment.

.........

On August 4, Wei Mu returned to his loyal Taihe wheat field with the trophy for the most popular singer.

"Old Song, how are you?"

He placed the trophy on the table in the boss's office and looked at Song Ke, who was puffing away his smoke.

Boss Song rolled his eyes at him, not wanting to see this guy show off.
